evidence_items.explanation: The original report places R1 close to o1 across mathematics, coding and knowledge tests. It also reports weaknesses, including lower factual-question performance, so the evidence supports competitiveness rather than universal equivalence.
The pricing section lists R1 at $0.55 per million uncached input tokens and $2.19 per million output tokens. These are the customer prices used in the comparison with e3.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI lists o1 at $15 per million uncached input tokens and $60 per million output tokens, including internal reasoning tokens. Against e2, R1's corresponding rates are about 96.3% lower.
